requirements.title: A primary is one of eleven expression atoms
requirements.definition: The syntactic class primary is exactly one of: literal-constant, designator, array-constructor, structure-constructor, enum-constructor, enumeration-constructor, function-reference, type-param-inquiry, type-param-name, parenthesized expr, or conditional-expr. The alternatives' internal formation and semantics remain with their owning subclauses.

pending.enum-constructor: PENDING positive-control source shape whose primary alternative is enum constructor and whose reached execution observes an independent literal value or inquiry result. The future plan must cite the owning subclause for the alternative and attribute only the R1001 primary admission to this requirement.
pending.enumeration-constructor: PENDING positive-control source shape whose primary alternative is enumeration constructor and whose reached execution observes an independent literal value or inquiry result. The future plan must cite the owning subclause for the alternative and attribute only the R1001 primary admission to this requirement.
pending.type-param-inquiry: PENDING positive-control source shape whose primary alternative is type param inquiry and whose reached execution observes an independent literal value or inquiry result. The future plan must cite the owning subclause for the alternative and attribute only the R1001 primary admission to this requirement.
pending.type-param-name: PENDING positive-control source shape whose primary alternative is type param name and whose reached execution observes an independent literal value or inquiry result. The future plan must cite the owning subclause for the alternative and attribute only the R1001 primary admission to this requirement.
pending.nonprimary-token-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape placing a token sequence that is not any R1001 alternative in an expression-primary position, such as an isolated comma between assignment operands. The repaired control replaces only that token sequence with literal 1 and observes literal 1, so the negative is attributable to R1001 rather than to declaration or operator applicability rules.

requirements.oracle:
Future positive controls each exercise one alternative with an independent literal or inquiry oracle. The one negative must fail before alternative-specific constraints, proving no R1001 alternative applies.

requirements.title: A type-param-name primary names a type parameter
requirements.definition: When the R1001 type-param-name alternative is used, the name shall be the name of a type parameter. An ordinary object, component, procedure, or undeclared name does not satisfy this constraint merely because it has identifier spelling.

pending.declared-type-parameter-name: PENDING positive-control source shape inside a parameterized derived-type definition using declared type parameter n as a primary in a specification expression and checking a component bound against integer literal n's value through a valid constructor. The oracle is the declared literal parameter value; 7.5.3.1 owns the type-parameter declaration.
pending.ordinary-name-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape in a context where the grammar path is the type-param-name primary within a derived-type definition, using an ordinary accessible name that is not a type parameter. Repair changes only the declaration to make the name a type parameter and then observes the literal bound, isolating C1001 rather than R1001 designator admission.
pending.undeclared-name-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape using an undeclared identifier as a type-param-name primary in a derived-type parameter expression, with all other declarations valid. Repair declares the same identifier as an INTEGER LEN type parameter with a literal value, so the violation is attributable to C1001 name status, not to malformed syntax.

requirements.oracle: Positive and negative plans must force the type-param-name alternative rather than an ordinary designator alternative. Diagnostics are for the numbered constraint; message text or rejection severity is not prescribed.

requirements.title: A primary designator is not a whole assumed-size array
requirements.definition: When the R1001 designator alternative is used as a primary, that designator shall not be a whole assumed-size array. Element, section with explicit upper bound, or non-assumed-size whole-array designators are outside this prohibition when otherwise valid.
requirements.oracle:
The negative plan must keep the assumed-size declaration valid and isolate the whole-designator use. Future positive controls need literal element observations and must not use storage association or address comparisons.

requirements.title: A parenthesized expr primary is not a procedure-pointer-valued function reference
requirements.definition: For the R1001 parenthesized expr alternative, the contained expr shall not be a function reference that returns a procedure pointer. Other parenthesized expressions remain admitted when their contained expression is valid.

pending.data-pointer-function-control: PENDING positive-control source shape with a function returning a data pointer, using the parenthesized reference only in a context where data-pointer result rules admit it, and checking a target literal. This distinguishes data pointer results from procedure pointer results while citing pointer-result owners.
pending.procedure-pointer-function-reference-rej: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape with a valid function whose result is a procedure pointer, placed as the entire expr inside parentheses in an otherwise valid primary context. Repair removes the parentheses or replaces the result with an ordinary data expression with a literal oracle, isolating C1003 rather than function interface syntax or procedure invocation rules.

requirements.oracle:
